newRecords.identityScope: Exact accepted COL26.8 species usage 75SVV. The evidence concerns handling responses of captured great tits in sampled European urban and rural populations; it is not a global behavior estimate or a complete species account.

claim.text: In a post-hoc analysis separating the sexes, male great tits with pecking measurements had higher pecking rates at urban than at paired rural sites (likelihood-ratio test LRT=4.79, p=0.03); the corresponding habitat effect was not detected in females (p=0.95). The overall habitat effect in the full pecking model was not significant (p=0.10). Pecking was counted during a 15-second handling trial within five minutes after capture. This result describes acute handling responses in the sampled populations; it does not establish a global species pattern, local adaptation, or the cause of the difference.
claim.textZh: 按性别分开的事后分析显示，在有啄击数据的大山雀中，城市地点雄鸟的啄击率高于配对的乡村地点（似然比检验 LRT=4.79，p=0.03）；雌鸟未检测到相应的栖息地效应（p=0.95）。完整啄击模型中的总体栖息地效应并不显著（p=0.10）。啄击是在捕获后五分钟内的 15 秒手持测试中计数的。该结果描述的是所采样种群的急性手持反应，不能证明全球性的物种模式、局地适应或差异成因。
claim.locator: Results, male pecking-rate model and post-hoc sex-stratified analysis; Table 5; Methods, Behavioral tests.
claim.placeTimeScope: Paired urban and rural populations at European localities sampled during 2014–2016. The overall study quantified 1,539 birds at seven paired localities, but pecking/distress-call tests were not recorded in Montpellier and Munich, where only breath rate was measured; the pecking result applies to the sites with those measurements. Barcelona sampling was January–April; other sites were sampled during their local breeding seasons.
claim.lifeStatus: Free-living wild birds captured at study sites and briefly handled for measurements; captive or domesticated populations were not studied.

newRecords.facetGap: The handling experiment measures a short acute response in sampled European populations; it does not establish global variation, selection versus plasticity, causal urban mechanisms, or current behavior.

newRecords.identityScope: Exact accepted COL26.8 species usage 3NCKV. The evidence concerns a supplementary-feeding field experiment on male treefrogs at two ponds in southern Germany, not species-wide calling rates or mating success.

claim.text: In paired field recordings from a supplementary-feeding experiment at two ponds in the Steigerwald, southern Germany, fed male European treefrogs called at 124±36.9 calls/min compared with 95.5±32.3 calls/min for paired controls (N=8 pairs, p<0.05). Males were temporarily held for 12 hours during treatment, and recordings were made 1–31 nights after treatment in 2002 and 1–2 nights after treatment in 2003. This small, site- and treatment-specific result does not estimate natural population-wide calling rates or demonstrate female preference or mating success.
claim.textZh: 在德国南部施泰格瓦尔德两处池塘进行的补充喂食野外实验配对录音中，补充喂食雄性欧洲树蛙的鸣叫率为每分钟 124±36.9 次，配对对照组为每分钟 95.5±32.3 次（N=8 对，p<0.05）。处理期间个体被暂时置于容器中 12 小时；2002 年在处理后 1–31 个夜晚录音，2003 年在处理后 1–2 个夜晚录音。这个小样本、特定地点和处理条件下的结果不能估计自然种群的总体鸣叫率，也不能证明雌性偏好或交配成功。

claim.placeTimeScope: Two breeding ponds in the Steigerwald, southern Germany; the study followed animals during 2002–2003. Calling-rate comparisons used paired recordings from the field, recorded 1–31 nights after treatment in 2002 and 1–2 nights after treatment in 2003.
claim.lifeStatus: Wild male frogs captured at breeding ponds for an experiment; animals were temporarily held in ventilated boxes for 12 hours during feeding/control treatment before field calling observations.

newRecords.facetGap: A small paired calling-rate experiment at two ponds does not establish natural population rates, geographic or annual variation, female preference, mating success, or a complete life-history account.

claim.text: In the first-year caged experiment on new cinderblock substrates at Conch Reef in the Florida Keys (November 2003–August 2004), redband parrotfish-only treatments had algal cover and biomass similar to herbivore-exclosure controls and showed no significant effect on measured algal groups except Dictyota spp. This is a single-site, caged-treatment result for algal succession on new substrates; it is not a range-wide estimate of grazing by free-ranging fish.
claim.textZh: 在佛罗里达礁岛群康奇礁的新混凝土砌块基质第一年围笼实验中（2003 年 11 月至 2004 年 8 月），仅放入红带鹦嘴鱼的处理组，其藻类覆盖度和生物量与草食动物排除对照相近；除 Dictyota 属外，对测量的藻类类群未显示显著影响。这是单一地点、围笼处理下针对新基质藻类演替的结果，不能作为自由活动鱼类摄食影响的全分布区估计。
